publicationDecision.appStoreConnectAction: Leave every accessibility feature unselected for iPhone and iPad. Add the public accessibility URL after it is deployed.
publicationDecision.ownerEvidenceRequired: Retain an App Store Connect screenshot or export showing no feature declarations and the saved accessibility URL.

remediationPolicy.summary: Known accessibility gaps remain present, but broad remediation is not currently scheduled. Reassess when direct accessibility reports or documented user needs justify the implementation and ongoing regression coverage.
remediationPolicy.reopenSignal: A specific user need identifying the affected puzzle flow, device, and assistive setting.

voiceOver.reason: Standard, Arrow Duel, Review, and Replay expose the puzzle board as one image without an accessible move-entry path.

voiceControl.reason: Puzzle moves cannot be completed by visible control name or numbered overlay.

largerText.reason: The largest accessibility text size clips or overlaps common controls on iPhone and landscape iPad.

sufficientContrast.reason: Verified common-task text pairs include 2.15:1 white-on-amber and 3.30:1 green-on-white contrast.

differentiateWithoutColorAlone.reason: No confirmed color-only blocker was found, but the complete grayscale common-task walkthrough is still pending.

reducedMotion.reason: The app does not observe the system Reduce Motion setting for board, layout, or reordering animations.

captions.reason: The app has no timed video or spoken media experience to support with captions.

audioDescriptions.reason: The app has no video experience requiring an audio-description track.

darkInterface.reason: The common puzzle interface remains light when iOS Dark Mode is enabled.

touchTargets.reason: Primary session and navigation controls are generally 44pt or larger, but shared Settings preference buttons are 34pt high without hit slop.

orientationAndIpad.reason: The exact-head Release app renders a usable two-column Practice layout in iPad landscape at the standard text size; Larger Text remains blocked separately.
